items.title: Flag mutation/cache keywords in prompts
items.description: When the prompt combines a mutation/cache keyword (stale cache, revalidate, useMutation, afterChange, ...) with a bug/error keyword, suggests `/rhize-devflow:mutation-check` before proceeding. Lets explicit /rhize-devflow:mutation-check invocations through unconditionally.

items.title: Warn on incomplete mutation patterns before write
items.description: On .ts/.tsx files under actions/api/hooks/mutations/collections/payload (or mutation-shaped filenames), warns when Supabase mutations lack error handling/revalidateTag/revalidatePath, useMutation calls lack onError/onSettled/query-key factories, or Payload CollectionConfig lacks afterChange/afterDelete. Fixed 2026-08-04: field extraction used GNU-only `grep -oP`, which macOS's default BSD grep rejects outright, so the hook silently never matched.

items.title: Detect Sentry/stale-data investigation prompts
items.description: When the prompt contains a sentry.io issue URL, or investigation + data/cache/mutation keywords, or explicit stale-data phrasing, prints a data-mutation-consistency investigation checklist. Fixed 2026-08-04: previously read the prompt from a positional $1 argument Claude Code never populates (it delivers UserPromptSubmit payloads as JSON on stdin); now reads and parses stdin.

items.title: Block edits to CI/env/billing files and leaked secrets
items.description: Blocks (exit 2) edits to .github/workflows/*, .env*, and billing/payment paths; also content-gates NEXT_PUBLIC_* secret-named vars and Supabase service-role references written into 'use client' files. Local per-plugin copy of the same gate as the global ~/.claude/hooks/protect-files.sh (that one already runs for every session regardless of this manifest; wire this one in only if you want the gate active even in environments without the global hook installed).

dependencies.name: Sentry MCP server
dependencies.purpose: Required by error-lifecycle-management (get_issues/get_issue/get_issue_events/get_performance_issues) and by sentry-instrumentation to verify conventions against real issues.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: error-lifecycle-management can't fetch issues, events, or performance data at all; sentry-instrumentation can still advise on Rhize's captureException/spans conventions from static guidance, but can't verify against live issues.

replacement.suggestion: read the Sentry dashboard manually and paste findings into the session
replacement.warning: the MCP server already returns issue/event/perf data in the structured form the skill parses directly; hand-pasting dashboard screenshots loses that structure and has to be redone for every investigation — connect the Sentry MCP server instead.

dependencies.name: Vercel MCP server
dependencies.purpose: Required by error-lifecycle-management (get_deployments/get_build_logs/get_functions_logs/get_environment) for Sentry↔Vercel deploy correlation.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: error-lifecycle-management can't correlate an error with the deployment that introduced it — no deployment, build-log, or env-var evidence.

replacement.suggestion: check the Vercel dashboard manually for the matching deployment
replacement.warning: same tradeoff as Sentry — the MCP server already returns this in a form the skill consumes automatically; manual dashboard lookups can't be automated and have to be repeated every triage.

dependencies.name: GitHub MCP server
dependencies.purpose: Required by error-lifecycle-management (get_commits/get_pull_request/create_issue/get_diff) to identify the commit/PR that likely caused an error and to file a bug ticket.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: error-lifecycle-management can't identify the causing commit/PR or auto-file a tracker issue.

replacement.suggestion: search git log and the GitHub UI manually, and file issues by hand
replacement.warning: the MCP server already ties commits, PRs, and issues together programmatically; manual correlation is slower and doesn't scale to recurring triage work.

dependencies.name: Chrome DevTools MCP server
dependencies.purpose: Required by the entire chrome-devtools-mcp skill — browser automation, perf traces, network/console debugging.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: The chrome-devtools-mcp skill can't run at all — there's no non-MCP fallback path documented for it.

replacement.suggestion: drive a browser manually or script it with Playwright directly
replacement.warning: Chrome DevTools MCP already wraps a wait-aware Puppeteer client tuned for this workflow; a hand-rolled Playwright script duplicates that work and has to be maintained separately.

dependencies.name: CodeGraph CLI
dependencies.purpose: Pre-indexes a target repository's code graph (symbols, callers, call paths) into a local .codegraph/ directory, used by /rhize-devflow:impact-map for structural discovery, by evidence for CodeGraph index presence/freshness, and by refactor_gate.py prepare/reconcile. See docs/codegraph-setup.md.
dependencies.degradedBehavior: impact-map, evidence, and refactor_gate.py fall back to rg-based text search — every consumer documents this fallback explicitly, so absence never blocks a command, but structural lookups lose call-path precision and can't follow dynamic-dispatch hops.

replacement.suggestion: rely on the built-in rg fallback rather than a hand-rolled alternative
replacement.warning: rg finds text matches, not structural call paths, and can't follow dynamic dispatch (callbacks, re-renders) the way CodeGraph's index does; installing the CodeGraph CLI (see docs/codegraph-setup.md) is simpler than trying to replicate its indexing by hand.

wizard.purpose: Set up the per-repo local-tenant-file convention error-lifecycle-management uses to keep client-specific error patterns out of a shared repo.

artifacts.purpose: Machine-local, gitignored client-specific error patterns supplementing the public error-lifecycle-management reference.
Prepared refactor-gate impact-map receipts, keyed by canonical workspace path, shared by Claude Code and Codex.
Fail-closed, state-bound test-evidence packets produced by /rhize-devflow:test-evidence.
